name: canonical_fraud_feature_schema
description: Canonical point-in-time safe fraud detection feature schema for IEEE-CIS and real-time production serving

features.name: amount
features.description: Transaction monetary amount in base currency units

features.name: ip_velocity_1h
features.description: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 1 hour [T-1h, T]
features.training_transform: Chronological rolling count over 3,600s window per IP/card proxy

features.name: ip_velocity_24h
features.description: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 24 hours [T-24h, T]
features.training_transform: Chronological rolling count over 86,400s window per IP/card proxy

features.name: token_velocity_24h
features.description: Number of transactions observed for payment instrument token in preceding 24 hours [T-24h, T]
features.training_transform: Chronological rolling count over 86,400s window per card/token

features.name: device_seen_before
features.description: 1 if device fingerprint was associated with account/tenant prior to time T; 0 if novel device
features.training_transform: Chronological stateful device first-seen lookup at time T
features.serving_transform: Inferred from device registry / fallback (1 - is_new_device)

features.name: transaction_hour
features.description: Hour of day (0-23) when transaction occurred

features.name: transaction_day
features.description: Day of week (0-6) when transaction occurred

features.name: product_cd_encoded
features.description: Ordinal encoded product category code (W, C, H, R, S)
features.training_transform: Ordinal mapping based strictly on train vocabulary

features.name: card_type_encoded
features.description: Ordinal encoded card network (visa, mastercard, discover, amex)
features.training_transform: Ordinal mapping based strictly on train vocabulary

features.name: card_category_encoded
features.description: Ordinal encoded card category (debit, credit, prepaid)
features.training_transform: Ordinal mapping based strictly on train vocabulary
features.serving_transform: Parsed from card bin lookup / default

features.name: email_domain_risk
features.description: Historical fraud risk score associated with purchaser email domain
features.training_transform: Domain risk weighting fitted strictly on train split
features.serving_transform: Heuristic domain risk map in serving layer

features.name: dist1_missing
features.description: Binary indicator (1 if address distance is missing/unknown, 0 otherwise)

features.name: device_type_mobile
features.description: 1 if device client is mobile, 0 if desktop or unknown

features.name: device_info_missing
features.description: Binary indicator (1 if device telemetry is missing, 0 if provided)

features.name: amount_to_mean_ratio
features.description: Ratio of transaction amount to trailing historical card mean amount
features.training_transform: TransactionAmt / cumulative_mean(TransactionAmt | card) up to T
